head: Remoqa: free remote desktop app to help family with their PC
dek: Remoqa is a new remote desktop app in public beta for Windows, Mac and Linux that lets you reach your own computer or help friends and family, with end-to-end encrypted sessions. The free plan covers up to 3 devices and one session at a time.
details: You can also share your screen from a desktop browser without installing anything, but that mode is view-only. Paid plans aren't listed yet. It's made by Pavel Mikhailiuk.
where: Windows, Mac and Linux, public beta
means: If you're the one who fixes your parents' computer, Remoqa is another free way to see and control their screen from afar.
todo: It's a beta, so keep the remote tool you already use as a backup; only give remote access to people you know.
